zadar.t: n. 扎达尔（克罗地亚城市）

e.en: We spent two days in {Zadar} watching sunsets by the sea.
e.zh: 我们在扎达尔待了两天，在海边看日落。

e.en: The sea organ in {Zadar} plays music with every wave.
e.zh: 扎达尔的海风琴随着每一道海浪奏响乐曲。

zag.t: v. 急转方向（与 zig 对应）

zagreb.t: n. 萨格勒布（克罗地亚首都）

e.en: Our flight lands in {Zagreb} early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们的航班明天一早降落在萨格勒布。

e.en: {Zagreb} is the capital and largest city of Croatia.
e.zh: 萨格勒布是克罗地亚的首都和最大城市。

zaibatsu.t: n. 财阀（日本大型家族企业集团）

e.en: Mitsubishi began as a powerful prewar Japanese {zaibatsu}.
e.zh: 三菱最初是一家强大的战前日本财阀。

e.en: Each {zaibatsu} controlled banks, factories, and trading firms.
e.zh: 每个财阀都掌控着银行、工厂和贸易公司。

e.en: The country once called {Zaire} is now the DRC.
e.zh: 曾被称为扎伊尔的国家如今是刚果民主共和国。

e.en: Mobutu ruled {Zaire} for more than three decades.
e.zh: 蒙博托统治扎伊尔长达三十多年。

zairean.t:
adj. 扎伊尔的
n. 扎伊尔人

e.en: The {Zairean} musicians performed soukous at the festival.
e.zh: 扎伊尔音乐家在音乐节上演奏苏库斯舞曲。

e.en: Her grandmother kept her old {Zairean} passport in a drawer.
e.zh: 她奶奶把旧的扎伊尔护照收在抽屉里。

zairian.t:
adj. 扎伊尔的
n. 扎伊尔人

e.en: He grew up speaking French and several {Zairian} languages.
e.zh: 他从小说法语和几种扎伊尔语言。

e.en: The documentary explored {Zairian} pop music of the 1980s.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了八十年代的扎伊尔流行音乐。

zakat.t: n. 天课（伊斯兰教法定施舍）

e.en: Many Muslims pay {zakat} once a year during Ramadan.
e.zh: 许多穆斯林在斋月期间一年缴纳一次天课。

e.en: {Zakat} is one of the five pillars of Islam.
e.zh: 天课是伊斯兰教五功之一。

zambezi.t: n. 赞比西河（非洲河流）

e.en: Victoria Falls plunges into a gorge on the {Zambezi}.
e.zh: 维多利亚瀑布奔流注入赞比西河的峡谷。

e.en: We took a sunset cruise along the {Zambezi} river.
e.zh: 我们沿着赞比西河参加了日落游船。

e.en: Copper mining drives much of the economy in {Zambia}.
e.zh: 采铜业是赞比亚经济的主要支柱。

e.en: {Zambia} shares Victoria Falls with neighboring Zimbabwe.
e.zh: 赞比亚与邻国津巴布韦共享维多利亚瀑布。

zambian.t:
adj. 赞比亚的
n. 赞比亚人

e.en: Our guide was a friendly {Zambian} student from Lusaka.
e.zh: 我们的向导是来自卢萨卡的一位友善赞比亚学生。

e.en: The {Zambian} team celebrated their first World Cup win.
e.zh: 赞比亚队庆祝他们的世界杯首胜。

zamora.t: n. 萨莫拉（西班牙城市）

e.en: The medieval walls of {Zamora} still ring the old town.
e.zh: 萨莫拉的中世纪城墙仍环绕着古城。

e.en: We tasted Tempranillo wines from the region around {Zamora}.
e.zh: 我们品尝了萨莫拉一带产的丹魄葡萄酒。

e.en: The {Zande} people live across South Sudan and Congo.
e.zh: 赞德人分布在南苏丹和刚果各地。

e.en: Anthropologists have long studied {Zande} witchcraft beliefs.
e.zh: 人类学家长期研究赞德人的巫术信仰。

e.en: The chef pan-fried a fillet of {zander} with lemon butter.
e.zh: 主厨用柠檬黄油香煎了一块梭鲈鱼柳。

e.en: Anglers caught several large {zander} from the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天钓友们在湖里钓到几条大梭鲈。

e.en: The show's charm lies in its sheer {zaniness}.
e.zh: 这部剧的魅力就在于它纯粹的搞怪劲儿。

e.en: Her {zaniness} keeps the office laughing all day.
e.zh: 她的疯癫劲儿让办公室整天笑声不断。

zany.t:
adj. 滑稽古怪的
n. 小丑

e.en: The kids loved the comedian's {zany} sound effects.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢这位喜剧演员搞怪的音效。

e.en: He came up with a {zany} plan to surprise her.
e.zh: 他想出一个滑稽古怪的计划来给她惊喜。

zanzibar.t: n. 桑给巴尔（坦桑尼亚岛屿）

e.en: We spent a week diving off the coast of {Zanzibar}.
e.zh: 我们在桑给巴尔海岸潜水了一周。

e.en: {Zanzibar} is famous for its spice plantations and beaches.
e.zh: 桑给巴尔以香料种植园和海滩闻名。

zap.t:
v. 快速删除、秒杀
n. 冲击、能量

e.en: He grabbed the TV {zapper} and switched to the news.
e.zh: 他抓起电视遥控器，切到了新闻频道。

e.en: The bug {zapper} on the porch hummed all summer night.
e.zh: 门廊上的灭蚊灯整个夏夜嗡嗡作响。

zara.t: n. 扎拉（女子名或品牌名）

e.en: She bought a black blazer at {Zara} for the interview.
e.zh: 她在Zara买了一件黑色西装外套去面试。

e.en: {Zara} releases new collections almost every other week.
e.zh: Zara几乎每两周就推出一批新款。

zaragoza.t: n. 萨拉戈萨（西班牙城市）

e.en: The basilica in {Zaragoza} draws pilgrims from across Spain.
e.zh: 萨拉戈萨的圣母大教堂吸引着全西班牙的朝圣者。

e.en: Our train to {Zaragoza} took just ninety minutes from Madrid.
e.zh: 我们从马德里到萨拉戈萨的火车只用了九十分钟。

zarathustra.t: n. 琐罗亚斯德（拜火教创始人）

e.en: Nietzsche's most famous book features the prophet {Zarathustra}.
e.zh: 尼采最著名的著作以先知查拉图斯特拉为主角。

e.en: {Zarathustra} founded one of the world's oldest religions.
e.zh: 查拉图斯特拉创立了世界上最古老的宗教之一。

zarzuela.t: n. 萨苏埃拉（西班牙轻歌剧）

e.en: We watched a {zarzuela} at the old Madrid theater.
e.zh: 我们在马德里老剧院看了一场轻歌剧。

e.en: The Catalan {zarzuela} stew is packed with seafood.
e.zh: 加泰罗尼亚海鲜杂烩里满是各种海鲜。

e.en: The {zookeeper} fed the penguins twice a day.
e.zh: 动物园管理员每天给企鹅喂食两次。

e.en: She trained as a {zookeeper} after studying biology.
e.zh: 她学完生物学后受训成为动物园管理员。

e.en: We visited the {zoological} gardens on Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们星期天下午参观了动物园。

e.en: The museum has an impressive {zoological} specimen collection.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了令人印象深刻的动物标本。

e.en: The {zoologist} studied tiger behavior in the wild.
e.zh: 这位动物学家在野外研究老虎的行为。

e.en: She became a {zoologist} after years of fieldwork.
e.zh: 经过多年的野外考察,她成为了一名动物学家。

e.en: {Zoologists} discovered a new frog species in the rainforest.
e.zh: 动物学家在雨林中发现了一种新的青蛙物种。

e.en: Several {zoologists} contributed research to the documentary.
e.zh: 几位动物学家为这部纪录片提供了研究资料。

e.en: She majored in {zoology} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里主修动物学。

e.en: His {zoology} textbook covers mammals and reptiles in detail.
e.zh: 他的动物学教科书详细介绍了哺乳动物和爬行动物。

zoom.t:
v. 放大/缩小（画面）
n. 视频会议软件 Zoom

e.en: Let's hop on a {Zoom} call after lunch.
e.zh: 我们午餐后来开个 Zoom 视频会议吧。

e.en: Pinch the screen to {zoom} into the photo.
e.zh: 用手指捏屏幕就可以放大照片。

e.en: The temple features {zoomorphic} carvings of lions and birds.
e.zh: 这座寺庙装饰着狮子和鸟类形状的兽形雕刻。

e.en: Ancient pottery often had {zoomorphic} handles shaped like animals.
e.zh: 古代陶器常带有动物造型的兽形把手。

zooms.t: v. 缩放（zoom 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The camera {zooms} in smoothly on the speaker's face.
e.zh: 摄像机平稳地推近到演讲者的脸部。

e.en: A sports car {zooms} past us on the highway.
e.zh: 一辆跑车在高速公路上从我们身旁飞驰而过。

e.en: Rabies is a serious {zoonotic} disease spread by animals.
e.zh: 狂犬病是一种通过动物传播的严重人畜共患病。

e.en: Scientists track {zoonotic} viruses to prevent future pandemics.
e.zh: 科学家追踪人畜共患病毒以预防未来的大流行。

e.en: Tiny {zooplankton} form the base of the ocean food chain.
e.zh: 微小的浮游动物构成了海洋食物链的基础。

e.en: Whales filter massive amounts of {zooplankton} from seawater.
e.zh: 鲸鱼从海水中过滤大量的浮游动物。

e.en: Modern {zoos} focus on conservation and education.
e.zh: 现代动物园专注于保护和教育工作。

e.en: The kids love visiting {zoos} during summer vacation.
e.zh: 孩子们暑假最喜欢去逛动物园。

zoroastrian.t:
adj. 琐罗亚斯德教的
n. 拜火教信徒

e.en: The {Zoroastrian} community celebrates Nowruz every spring.
e.zh: 琐罗亚斯德教社区每年春天庆祝诺鲁孜节。

e.en: Ancient Persia was largely a {Zoroastrian} empire.
e.zh: 古代波斯在很大程度上是一个琐罗亚斯德教帝国。

zoser.t: n. 左塞尔（古埃及法老）

e.en: Pharaoh {Zoser} built the famous Step Pyramid at Saqqara.
e.zh: 法老左塞尔在萨卡拉建造了著名的阶梯金字塔。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered new chambers beneath {Zoser}'s pyramid.
e.zh: 考古学家在左塞尔金字塔下发现了新的墓室。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her rash as herpes {zoster}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的皮疹为带状疱疹。

e.en: Older adults should consider getting the {zoster} vaccine.
e.zh: 老年人应该考虑接种带状疱疹疫苗。

e.en: Many southern lawns use {zoysia} grass for its drought tolerance.
e.zh: 许多南方草坪因结缕草的耐旱性而选用它。

e.en: The golf course replaced its fairways with {zoysia}.
e.zh: 高尔夫球场把球道换成了结缕草。

e.en: I grilled some {zucchini} with olive oil and salt.
e.zh: 我用橄榄油和盐烤了一些西葫芦。

e.en: Her grandmother's {zucchini} bread recipe is a family favorite.
e.zh: 她奶奶的西葫芦面包食谱是全家人的最爱。

e.en: He learned a few {Zulu} phrases before traveling to Durban.
e.zh: 去德班旅行前,他学了几句祖鲁语。

e.en: Military pilots use {Zulu} time to coordinate operations.
e.zh: 军事飞行员使用祖鲁时间协调作战行动。

e.en: The conference will be held in {Zurich} next October.
e.zh: 会议将于明年十月在苏黎世举行。

e.en: {Zurich} is famous for its banks and pristine lake.
e.zh: 苏黎世以其银行业和清澈的湖泊而闻名。

zydeco.t: n. 柴迪科音乐（美国路易斯安那民谣）

e.en: The festival features live {zydeco} bands every Saturday night.
e.zh: 音乐节每周六晚上都有柴迪科乐队现场演出。

e.en: She learned to dance to {zydeco} music in Louisiana.
e.zh: 她在路易斯安那州学会了跟着柴迪科音乐跳舞。

e.en: The {zygomatic} bone forms the prominence of the cheek.
e.zh: 颧骨构成了脸颊隆起的部分。

e.en: Smiling activates muscles attached to the {zygomatic} arch.
e.zh: 微笑会激活附着在颧弓上的肌肉。

e.en: A {zygote} forms when sperm fertilizes an egg.
e.zh: 当精子使卵子受精时就形成了受精卵。

e.en: The {zygote} divides rapidly during the first week.
e.zh: 受精卵在第一周内迅速分裂。

zzz.t: n. 表示睡觉的拟声符号

e.en: After paying rent, I had {zilch} left in my account.
e.zh: 付完房租后,我账户里一分钱都没剩。

e.en: He knows {zilch} about cars but loves to give advice.
e.zh: 他对汽车一窍不通,却很爱给人出主意。

e.en: I've told you a {zillion} times to lock the door.
e.zh: 我已经跟你说过无数遍要锁门了。

e.en: There are a {zillion} apps that promise to boost productivity.
e.zh: 有数不清的应用都号称能提升工作效率。

e.en: He acts like a {zillionaire} but barely covers his bills.
e.zh: 他装得像个超级富豪,实际上账单都快付不起。

e.en: That tech founder became a {zillionaire} after the IPO.
e.zh: 那位科技创始人在公司上市后变成了超级富豪。

e.en: {Zimbabwe} is famous for the spectacular Victoria Falls.
e.zh: 津巴布韦以壮观的维多利亚瀑布而闻名。

e.en: She traveled across {Zimbabwe} on a wildlife photography trip.
e.zh: 她为了拍摄野生动物穿越了整个津巴布韦。

zimbabwean.t:
adj. 津巴布韦的
n. 津巴布韦人

e.en: The {Zimbabwean} runner set a new national marathon record.
e.zh: 那位津巴布韦选手刷新了全国马拉松纪录。

e.en: My neighbor cooks delicious {Zimbabwean} dishes every weekend.
e.zh: 我的邻居每个周末都会做美味的津巴布韦菜肴。

e.en: Grandma uses a {zimmer} frame to walk around the house.
e.zh: 奶奶用助行架在屋里走动。

e.en: After surgery, he relied on a {zimmer} for several weeks.
e.zh: 手术后,他靠助行架走路用了好几周。

e.en: Many cold remedies contain {zinc} to shorten symptom duration.
e.zh: 许多感冒药含有锌,以缩短症状持续时间。

e.en: The barn roof is made of corrugated {zinc} sheets.
e.zh: 那座谷仓的屋顶是用波纹锌板做的。

e.en: She publishes a monthly {zine} about local punk music.
e.zh: 她每月出版一本关于本地朋克音乐的小杂志。

e.en: The bookstore sells handmade {zines} by independent artists.
e.zh: 那家书店出售独立艺术家手工制作的小杂志。

zinfandel.t: n. 仙粉黛（葡萄酒品种）

e.en: We opened a bottle of {zinfandel} to go with dinner.
e.zh: 我们开了一瓶仙粉黛葡萄酒来配晚餐。

e.en: This Californian {zinfandel} has rich blackberry notes.
e.zh: 这款加州仙粉黛带有浓郁的黑莓香气。

zing.t:
n. 活力；劲头
v. 快速飞过

e.en: A squeeze of lemon adds {zing} to the soup.
e.zh: 挤一点柠檬汁能给汤增添一份鲜活的味道。

e.en: Her witty replies gave the conversation real {zing}.
e.zh: 她机智的回应让对话充满了活力。

e.en: The comedian opened the show with a hilarious {zinger}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员用一句爆笑金句开场。

e.en: She delivered a {zinger} that left the debaters speechless.
e.zh: 她抛出一句犀利的话,让辩论者无言以对。

e.en: The dressing has a {zingy} citrus flavor I really enjoy.
e.zh: 这款酱汁带有我特别喜欢的清新柑橘味。

e.en: She chose a {zingy} orange paint for the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 她为厨房墙面选了一种鲜亮的橙色漆。

e.en: Bright {zinnias} bloomed all summer along the garden path.
e.zh: 鲜艳的百日草在花园小径旁开了一整个夏天。

e.en: She planted {zinnia} seeds to attract butterflies to her yard.
e.zh: 她种下百日草种子,以吸引蝴蝶来到院子里。

e.en: We hiked the narrow canyons of {Zion} National Park.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿越了锡安国家公园的狭长峡谷。

e.en: The hymn refers to {Zion} as a symbol of paradise.
e.zh: 这首圣歌把锡安描述为天堂的象征。

e.en: The history class examined the origins of modern {Zionism}.
e.zh: 历史课探讨了现代犹太复国主义的起源。

e.en: Theodor Herzl is often called the founder of political {Zionism}.
e.zh: 西奥多·赫茨尔常被称为政治犹太复国主义的创始人。

zionist.t:
n. 犹太复国主义者
adj. 犹太复国主义的

e.en: He attended a {Zionist} conference held in Basel.
e.zh: 他参加了在巴塞尔举行的一次犹太复国主义大会。

e.en: The {Zionist} movement gained momentum in the late 1800s.
e.zh: 犹太复国主义运动在十九世纪末逐渐兴起。

zip.t:
n. 拉链；压缩文件
v. 压缩；拉上拉链

zipped.t: adj. 已压缩的；已拉上拉链的

e.en: She {zipped} her jacket up against the cold wind.
e.zh: 她拉上夹克拉链以抵御寒风。

e.en: I {zipped} the files and emailed them to my boss.
e.zh: 我把文件压缩后发邮件给了老板。

e.en: The {zipper} on my backpack broke during the hike.
e.zh: 我背包的拉链在徒步途中坏了。

e.en: This jacket has a waterproof {zipper} along the front.
e.zh: 这件夹克前面有一条防水拉链。

e.en: She stored her passport in a {zippered} pocket for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全,她把护照放在带拉链的口袋里。

e.en: The bag has a {zippered} compartment for laptops.
e.zh: 这个包有一个带拉链的笔记本电脑隔层。

e.en: His grandfather's old {Zippo} lighter still works perfectly.
e.zh: 他爷爷那只老Zippo打火机依然好使。

e.en: I asked for help and got {zippo} in return.
e.zh: 我请人帮忙，结果一点回应都没有。

e.en: The new electric scooter is surprisingly {zippy} on hills.
e.zh: 这款新电动滑板车上坡时意外地灵活有力。

e.en: She wrote a {zippy} opening line that hooked readers immediately.
e.zh: 她写了个轻快的开头句，立刻抓住了读者。

zips.t:
n. 拉链（复数）
v. 压缩；拉上（第三人称）

e.en: The courier {zips} through traffic on his electric bike.
e.zh: 快递员骑着电动车在车流中飞快穿行。

e.en: My jacket has two side {zips} for ventilation.
e.zh: 我的夹克两侧有两个透气拉链。

e.en: Geologists dated the rock using tiny {zircon} crystals.
e.zh: 地质学家用微小的锆石晶体测定了这块岩石的年代。

e.en: Her ring sparkled with a pale blue {zircon} stone.
e.zh: 她的戒指上镶着一颗淡蓝色的锆石。

e.en: Cubic {zirconia} looks like diamond but costs far less.
e.zh: 立方氧化锆看起来像钻石，但价格便宜得多。

e.en: The dentist fitted her with a {zirconia} crown.
e.zh: 牙医给她装了一颗氧化锆牙冠。

e.en: Nuclear fuel rods are often clad in {zirconium} alloy.
e.zh: 核燃料棒外层通常包覆锆合金。

e.en: {Zirconium} resists corrosion even at very high temperatures.
e.zh: 锆即使在极高温度下也能耐腐蚀。

e.en: He plucked a haunting melody on the old {zither}.
e.zh: 他在那把旧齐特琴上弹出一段萦绕心头的旋律。

e.en: The Third Man's famous theme is played on a {zither}.
e.zh: 《第三人》中那段著名主题曲是用齐特琴演奏的。

ziti.t: n. 吉提面（意式管状面）

e.en: She baked a tray of {ziti} with mozzarella and sausage.
e.zh: 她烤了一盘加马苏里拉和香肠的通心粉。

e.en: Baked {ziti} is a comforting weeknight dinner staple.
e.zh: 焗通心粉是工作日晚餐的温暖经典。

e.en: I exchanged some euros for Polish {zloty} at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场把一些欧元换成了波兰兹罗提。

e.en: The hotel room cost about three hundred {zloty} per night.
e.zh: 酒店房间每晚大约三百兹罗提。

e.en: Many readers check their {zodiac} horoscope every morning.
e.zh: 许多读者每天早上都会看自己的星座运势。

e.en: The Chinese {zodiac} assigns an animal to each year.
e.zh: 中国生肖给每一年都分配一个动物。

e.en: On clear nights you can see the faint {zodiacal} light.
e.zh: 在晴朗的夜晚可以看到淡淡的黄道光。

e.en: Astrologers study the {zodiacal} signs to make predictions.
e.zh: 占星家研究黄道星座来作出预言。

e.en: The museum displayed a Victorian {zoetrope} with spinning horses.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台维多利亚时代的旋转奔马走马灯。

e.en: A {zoetrope} creates the illusion of motion through slits.
e.zh: 走马灯通过缝隙制造出动态的幻觉。

e.en: Emile {Zola} wrote unflinching novels about working-class Paris.
e.zh: 埃米尔·左拉写了不少描写巴黎工人阶级的写实小说。

e.en: {Zola}'s open letter shook France during the Dreyfus affair.
e.zh: 左拉的公开信在德雷福斯事件中震动了整个法国。

e.en: He stumbled in like a {zombie} after pulling an all-nighter.
e.zh: 通宵之后他像僵尸一样跌跌撞撞地走进来。

e.en: A {zombie} process was eating up half the server's memory.
e.zh: 一个僵尸进程占用了服务器一半的内存。

e.en: The producer {Zomby} dropped a new dubstep track last week.
e.zh: 制作人Zomby上周发布了一首新的回响贝斯曲目。

e.en: Critics praised {Zomby}'s eerie, lo-fi production style.
e.zh: 乐评人称赞Zomby那种诡异的低保真制作风格。

e.en: The defenders switched to a {zonal} marking system.
e.zh: 防守球员改用区域盯人防守体系。

e.en: City planners proposed new {zonal} restrictions on tall buildings.
e.zh: 城市规划者提出了对高层建筑的新分区限制。

zone.t:
n. 区域；地带
v. 划分区域

e.en: Please don't park in the loading {zone}.
e.zh: 请不要停在装卸区。

e.en: When I'm coding I sometimes get into the {zone}.
e.zh: 我写代码时有时会进入心流状态。

zoned.t: adj. 已划区的；（俚）走神的

e.en: This area is {zoned} for residential use only.
e.zh: 这片区域被划定为仅限住宅用途。

e.en: I totally {zoned} out during the long meeting.
e.zh: 开长会的时候我完全走神了。

zones.t:
n. 区域（复数）
v. 划区（第三人称）

e.en: The app shows delivery {zones} on a color-coded map.
e.zh: 这款应用在彩色编码地图上显示配送区域。

e.en: Different time {zones} make scheduling calls tricky.
e.zh: 不同的时区让安排通话变得棘手。

e.en: The city council updated the {zoning} laws last month.
e.zh: 市议会上个月更新了分区规划法规。

e.en: I keep {zoning} out whenever the lecture gets boring.
e.zh: 每次讲座变得无聊时我就会走神。

e.en: That cold medicine will totally {zonk} you out.
e.zh: 那种感冒药会让你彻底昏睡过去。

e.en: After the hike, I {zonk} out the moment I sit down.
e.zh: 徒步之后我一坐下就立刻昏睡过去。

zoo.t: n. 动物园；乱哄哄的地方

e.en: She tackled the new project with surprising {zeal}.
e.zh: 她以惊人的热情投入到这个新项目里。

e.en: His religious {zeal} sometimes made his coworkers uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他的宗教狂热有时让同事们感到不自在。

zealand.t: n. 西兰（丹麦岛屿；亦指新西兰）

e.en: Copenhagen sits on the eastern coast of {Zealand}.
e.zh: 哥本哈根坐落在西兰岛的东海岸。

e.en: New {Zealand} is famous for its dramatic mountain landscapes.
e.zh: 新西兰以其壮丽的山地风光闻名。

e.en: As a New {Zealander}, she grew up hiking near Auckland.
e.zh: 作为新西兰人，她从小在奥克兰附近徒步。

e.en: The team includes two New {Zealanders} and an Australian.
e.zh: 队里有两位新西兰人和一位澳大利亚人。

zealot.t: n. 狂热分子；极端拥护者

e.en: He's become a fitness {zealot} since turning forty.
e.zh: 四十岁以后他成了健身狂热分子。

e.en: The forum was overrun by political {zealots} shouting slogans.
e.zh: 论坛被一群高喊口号的政治狂热分子占据了。

zealotry.t: n. 狂热行为；盲目崇拜

e.en: Religious {zealotry} fueled the conflict for decades.
e.zh: 宗教狂热使这场冲突持续了数十年。

e.en: Her dieting {zealotry} began to worry her close friends.
e.zh: 她对节食的狂热让密友们开始担心。

e.en: He is a {zealous} defender of free speech online.
e.zh: 他是网络言论自由的热忱捍卫者。

e.en: The new manager is {zealous} about hitting quarterly targets.
e.zh: 新经理对完成季度目标非常热衷。

e.en: She {zealously} guards her privacy on social media.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上极力保护自己的隐私。

e.en: The lawyer {zealously} represented her client in court.
e.zh: 那位律师在法庭上全力为当事人辩护。

e.en: His {zealousness} for recycling impressed the whole neighborhood.
e.zh: 他对回收的热忱让整个社区都很佩服。

e.en: The coach's {zealousness} sometimes pushed players too hard.
e.zh: 教练的狂热劲儿有时把队员们逼得太紧。

zeaxanthin.t: n. 玉米黄质（一种类胡萝卜素）

e.en: Spinach and kale are rich in lutein and {zeaxanthin}.
e.zh: 菠菜和羽衣甘蓝富含叶黄素和玉米黄质。

e.en: {Zeaxanthin} helps protect the retina from blue light damage.
e.zh: 玉米黄质有助于保护视网膜免受蓝光损伤。

e.en: In the gospels, {Zebedee} was the father of James and John.
e.zh: 在福音书中，西庇太是雅各和约翰的父亲。

e.en: British kids of the seventies remember {Zebedee} from the Magic Roundabout.
e.zh: 七十年代的英国孩子还记得《魔法转盘》里的Zebedee。

e.en: A {zebra} stood grazing quietly beside the watering hole.
e.zh: 一只斑马在水坑边静静地吃草。

e.en: Always cross the road at the {zebra} crossing.
e.zh: 过马路一定要走斑马线。

e.en: A small herd of {zebras} drifted across the savanna.
e.zh: 一小群斑马慢慢穿过草原。

e.en: The {zebras} at the zoo were huddled under a tree.
e.zh: 动物园里的斑马都挤在一棵树下。

zechstein.t: n. 镁灰岩统（二叠纪晚期地层）

zeebrugge.t: n. 泽布吕赫（比利时港口）

zeiss.t: n. 蔡司（德国光学品牌）

zeitgeist.t: n. 时代精神；社会思潮

zelda.t: n. 塞尔达（女名；游戏名）

e.en: Her career reached its {zenith} when she won the Nobel Prize.
e.zh: 她获得诺贝尔奖时事业达到了顶峰。

e.en: The sun was at its {zenith} by noon over the desert.
e.zh: 正午时分,太阳高悬在沙漠上空的最高点。

e.en: The map uses a {zenithal} projection centered on the North Pole.
e.zh: 这张地图采用以北极为中心的天顶投影。

e.en: Tropical regions receive {zenithal} sunlight twice a year.
e.zh: 热带地区每年会有两次太阳直射。

zeno.t: n. 芝诺（古希腊哲学家）

e.en: {Zeno} of Elea is famous for his paradoxes about motion.
e.zh: 埃利亚的芝诺以关于运动的悖论而闻名。

e.en: The philosophy class spent a week debating {Zeno}'s arrow paradox.
e.zh: 哲学课花了一周讨论芝诺的飞矢悖论。

e.en: {Zeolite} filters are widely used to soften hard water.
e.zh: 沸石过滤器被广泛用于软化硬水。

e.en: The catalyst contains a synthetic {zeolite} for cracking petroleum.
e.zh: 该催化剂含有用于裂化石油的合成沸石。

e.en: A gentle {zephyr} cooled the picnickers under the oak tree.
e.zh: 一阵轻柔的微风为橡树下野餐的人们带来凉意。

e.en: She wore a light {zephyr} dress to the summer party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条轻薄的薄纱连衣裙去参加夏日派对。

e.en: A massive {zeppelin} drifted silently across the cloudy sky.
e.zh: 一艘巨大的齐柏林飞艇静静地飘过多云的天空。

e.en: The museum displays a model of a 1930s {zeppelin}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘1930年代齐柏林飞艇的模型。

zermatt.t: n. 采尔马特（瑞士小镇）

e.en: We took the train to {Zermatt} to ski near the Matterhorn.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去采尔马特,在马特洪峰附近滑雪。

e.en: {Zermatt} is a car-free village in the Swiss Alps.
e.zh: 采尔马特是瑞士阿尔卑斯山中的一个无车小镇。

zero.t:
n. 零；零点
adj. 毫无的

e.en: The temperature dropped below {zero} overnight.
e.zh: 夜间气温降到了零度以下。

e.en: Our chances of winning are basically {zero} at this point.
e.zh: 事到如今,我们获胜的机会基本为零。

zest.t:
n. 热情；兴致
n. 柠檬皮屑

e.en: She approached every project with great {zest} and energy.
e.zh: 她对每个项目都充满热情和干劲。

e.en: Add a teaspoon of lemon {zest} to the cake batter.
e.zh: 在蛋糕面糊里加一茶匙柠檬皮屑。

e.en: Use a {zester} to grate the orange peel finely.
e.zh: 用刨皮器把橙皮细细地刨下来。

e.en: My new {zester} makes garnishing cocktails so much easier.
e.zh: 我的新刨皮器让调制鸡尾酒的装饰工作轻松多了。

zestful.t: adj. 充满热情的；带劲的

e.en: Her {zestful} laugh filled the entire dining room.
e.zh: 她爽朗的笑声充满了整个餐厅。

e.en: He gave a {zestful} performance that thrilled the audience.
e.zh: 他充满激情的表演让观众大为震撼。

e.en: The salad had a {zesty} lime dressing that everyone loved.
e.zh: 沙拉配着一种人人都爱的浓郁青柠酱汁。

e.en: This {zesty} salsa pairs perfectly with grilled fish.
e.zh: 这款风味浓郁的莎莎酱与烤鱼是绝配。

e.en: The Greek letter {zeta} is the sixth in the alphabet.
e.zh: 希腊字母zeta是字母表中的第六个。

e.en: Riemann's {zeta} function is central to number theory.
e.zh: 黎曼ζ函数在数论中占据核心地位。

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Zeus} ruled the gods from Mount Olympus.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,宙斯在奥林匹斯山上统领众神。

e.en: The temple of {Zeus} once stood at the heart of Olympia.
e.zh: 宙斯神庙曾矗立在奥林匹亚的中心。

zhivago.t: n. 日瓦戈（《日瓦戈医生》主角）

e.en: Doctor {Zhivago} remains one of the most beloved Russian novels.
e.zh: 《日瓦戈医生》至今仍是最受喜爱的俄罗斯小说之一。

e.en: The film adaptation of {Zhivago} won five Academy Awards.
e.zh: 《日瓦戈医生》的电影改编版赢得了五项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: The {Zhou} dynasty lasted nearly eight centuries in ancient China.
e.zh: 周朝在古代中国延续了近八百年。

e.en: Premier {Zhou} Enlai shaped modern Chinese diplomacy.
e.zh: 周恩来总理塑造了现代中国的外交格局。

zidovudine.t: n. 齐多夫定（抗艾滋病药）

e.en: Doctors prescribe {zidovudine} as part of HIV treatment regimens.
e.zh: 医生将齐多夫定作为艾滋病治疗方案的一部分开具。

e.en: {Zidovudine} was the first approved drug for treating AIDS.
e.zh: 齐多夫定是首个获批用于治疗艾滋病的药物。

zig.t: v. 急转方向（zigzag 的一半）

ziggurat.t: n. 金字形神塔（美索不达米亚）

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered an ancient {ziggurat} in southern Iraq.
e.zh: 考古学家在伊拉克南部发掘出一座古代金字塔形神庙。

e.en: The Mesopotamian {ziggurat} towered over the surrounding city.
e.zh: 那座美索不达米亚的塔庙高耸于周围的城市之上。

zigzag.t:
n. 锯齿形
v. 曲折行进

e.en: The trail {zigzags} steeply up the side of the mountain.
e.zh: 那条小径沿着山坡曲折陡峭地向上延伸。

e.en: She drew a {zigzag} pattern across the bottom of the page.
e.zh: 她在页面底部画了一道之字形的图案。

zaniest.t: n. 小丑, 笨人, 马屁精\na. 滑稽的, 滑稽愚蠢的

zanier.t: n. 小丑, 笨人, 马屁精\na. 滑稽的, 滑稽愚蠢的

zapping.t:
vt. 杀死, 快速推动, 闪电般击中
vi. 快速移动
n. 活力, 精力, 震击
interj. (表示快速)嚓

zapped.t:
vt. 杀死, 快速推动, 闪电般击中
vi. 快速移动
n. 活力, 精力, 震击
interj. (表示快速)嚓

zaps.t:
vt. 杀死, 快速推动, 闪电般击中
vi. 快速移动
n. 活力, 精力, 震击
interj. (表示快速)嚓

zed.t: abbr. 玉米纤维；区带电泳（zone electrophoresis）

zigged.t: n. 锯齿状的角折转变, 改变方向, 急转\nvi. 转弯

zigs.t: n. 锯齿状的角折转变, 改变方向, 急转\nvi. 转弯

zipping.t: n. 尖啸声, 拉链, 活力\nvt. 给...以速度, 使增加活力, 拉(拉链)\nvi. 有力而迅速地行动, 嘘嘘地响, 拉拉链

e.en: The old vase was painted in deep {zaffre}.
e.zh: 那只旧花瓶涂成了深沉的藏青蓝色。

e.en: Artists once used {zaffre} to color glass.
e.zh: 画工过去曾用钴蓝颜料给玻璃上色。

e.en: The portrait showed a {zaftig} woman in red.
e.zh: 画像中是一位穿红衣的丰满女子。

e.en: Her {zaftig} figure challenged the fashion ideal.
e.zh: 她圆润的身材挑战了时尚界的审美标准。

e.en: They waited in the cool {zaguan} before entering.
e.zh: 他们进屋前在凉爽的入口通道里等候。

e.en: The colonial house had a tiled {zaguan}.
e.zh: 那座殖民时期的房子有一条铺砖门廊。

e.en: The navigator checked the {zaimuth} before sunset.
e.zh: 领航员在日落前核对了方位角。

e.en: An old chart marked the star's {zaimuth}.
e.zh: 一张旧星图标出了那颗星的地平方位。

e.en: The table was covered with {zakuski} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐前，桌上摆满了俄式开胃小菜。

e.en: They served vodka with pickled {zakuski}.
e.zh: 他们用腌制小菜配伏特加招待客人。

e.en: The point moved upward along the {z-axis}.
e.zh: 这个点沿着z轴向上移动。

e.en: Depth is often shown on the {z-axis}.
e.zh: 深度常常显示在z轴上。

e.en: The carpenter fastened a {z-bar} across the panel.
e.zh: 木匠在面板上固定了一根Z形条。

e.en: A {z-bar} can stiffen the back of a door.
e.zh: Z形杆可以加固门的背面。

e.en: Workers loaded the panels onto a {z-car}.
e.zh: 工人把面板装到一辆专用小车上。

e.en: The factory used a {z-car} to move heavy frames.
e.zh: 工厂用Z形支架车搬运沉重框架。

e.en: The clinic entered the patient's {z-code} in the form.
e.zh: 诊所在表格中录入了患者的Z代码。

e.en: This machine reads a {z-code} before starting.
e.zh: 这台机器启动前会读取一个专用代码。

e.en: The program stores the {z-coordinate} of every point.
e.zh: 程序会存储每个点的z坐标。

e.en: Change the {z-coordinate} to move the model forward.
e.zh: 调整z坐标可以让模型向前移动。

e.en: The assay had a high {z-factor}.
e.zh: 这项检测的Z因子很高。

e.en: Researchers use the {z-factor} to judge screening quality.
e.zh: 研究人员用Z因子评估筛选质量。

e.en: She served strawberries with warm {zabaglione}.
e.zh: 她用温热的意式蛋黄甜酒酱配草莓。

e.en: The chef whisked the {zabaglione} over gentle heat.
e.zh: 厨师隔着小火搅打那份意式蛋黄甜酒酱。

e.en: The hillside was covered with tall {zacaton}.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了高高的墨西哥粗草。

e.en: Ranchers cut {zacaton} for rough bedding.
e.zh: 牧场主割下粗草用作简易垫料。

e.en: The villagers revered him as a {zaddik}.
e.zh: 村民把他尊为犹太教中的义人。

e.en: Stories of the {zaddik} spread through the community.
e.zh: 关于那位圣贤的故事在社群中流传。

e.en: The herders built a {zariba} around the camp.
e.zh: 牧民在营地周围筑起一道灌木围栏。

e.en: At night, the cattle were kept inside the {zariba}.
e.zh: 夜里，牛群被关在围寨里面。

e.en: Several Russian {zars} ruled with absolute power.
e.zh: 几位俄国沙皇都以绝对权力统治国家。

e.en: The museum displayed portraits of the old {zars}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了昔日沙皇们的画像。

e.en: A sharp {zastruga} cut across the frozen plain.
e.zh: 一道尖锐的风蚀雪脊横亘在冰封平原上。

e.en: The skiers slowed when they reached the {zastruga}.
e.zh: 滑雪者到达那片风蚀雪脊时放慢了速度。

e.en: The roofer used a {zax} to trim the slate.
e.zh: 屋顶工用石板斧修整那块石板。

e.en: An old {zax} hung beside the workbench.
e.zh: 一把旧屋瓦斧挂在工作台旁边。

e.en: The letter {zayin} appears in the Hebrew alphabet.
e.zh: 字母zayin出现在希伯来字母表中。

e.en: She wrote {zayin} carefully on the board.
e.zh: 她在黑板上认真写下希伯来字母zayin。

e.en: The monks practiced {zazen} before dawn.
e.zh: 僧侣们在黎明前练习坐禅。

e.en: Daily {zazen} helped her sit with difficult thoughts.
e.zh: 每天禅坐帮助她平静面对艰难的念头。

e.en: A young {zealant} argued for reform at every meeting.
e.zh: 一位年轻的热心者在每次会议上都主张改革。

e.en: The pamphlet was written by a religious {zealant}.
e.zh: 这本小册子出自一位宗教狂热者之手。

e.en: Her {zealful} speech stirred the whole committee.
e.zh: 她充满热忱的演讲打动了整个委员会。

e.en: The volunteers made a {zealful} effort to help.
e.zh: 志愿者们满怀热情地努力提供帮助。

e.en: His {zealless} reply disappointed the campaign team.
e.zh: 他毫无热忱的回答让竞选团队失望。

e.en: A {zealless} manager rarely inspires loyal workers.
e.zh: 缺乏热情的经理很少能激励忠诚的员工。

e.en: The leader's {zealotic} tone worried moderate supporters.
e.zh: 那位领袖狂热的语气让温和支持者担心。

e.en: They rejected his {zealotic} demands for purity.
e.zh: 他们拒绝了他偏执地要求纯粹性的主张。

e.en: The lab tested the grain for {zearalenone}.
e.zh: 实验室检测谷物中是否含有玉米赤霉烯酮。

e.en: High {zearalenone} levels can affect livestock health.
e.zh: 玉米赤霉烯酮含量过高会影响牲畜健康。

zeatin.t: 玉米素；植物细胞分裂素

e.en: Researchers added {zeatin} to the plant culture.
e.zh: 研究人员向植物培养物中加入了玉米素。

e.en: The hormone {zeatin} can encourage cell division.
e.zh: 玉米素这种激素能够促进细胞分裂。

e.en: Doctors once linked {zeism} to diets based almost entirely on maize.
e.zh: 医生曾把玉米膳食依赖症与几乎完全依赖玉米的饮食联系起来。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {zeism} as a historical nutritional disorder.
e.zh: 讲座把玉米膳食依赖症作为一种历史上的营养障碍提到。

e.en: The memoir describes life as a {zek} in a remote camp.
e.zh: 这本回忆录描写了一个苏联劳改营囚犯在偏远营地的生活。

e.en: He used the word {zek} for prisoners in the Soviet labor system.
e.zh: 他用苏联劳改营囚犯这个词来称呼苏联劳动营制度下的囚犯。

e.en: Each runner pinned a {zekken} to the front of the shirt.
e.zh: 每位跑者都把号码布别在上衣前面。

e.en: The marshal checked the {zekken} before the match began.
e.zh: 裁判在比赛开始前检查了参赛布牌。

e.en: At every party, he became a social {Zelig}.
e.zh: 在每个聚会上，他都像个会随环境变色的人。

e.en: Critics called the adviser a political {Zelig} with no fixed beliefs.
e.zh: 评论家称这位顾问是没有固定信念的政治变色龙。

e.en: The choir sang a traditional {zemer} after dinner.
e.zh: 合唱团在晚餐后唱了一首传统希伯来赞歌。

e.en: She learned the old {zemer} from her grandfather.
e.zh: 她从祖父那里学会了那首古老的希伯来歌曲。

e.en: The British officials negotiated with a powerful {zemindar}.
e.zh: 英国官员同一位有权势的印度地主谈判。

e.en: A {zemindar} collected revenue from several villages.
e.zh: 一名税收承包人从几个村庄征收税款。

zemindary.t: 印度地主领地；地主制度

e.en: The family lost its {zemindary} after the reform.
e.zh: 改革后，这个家族失去了自己的印度地主领地。

e.en: Historians still debate the effects of the {zemindary} system.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论印度地主制度的影响。

e.en: The {zemstvo} built schools and clinics in the province.
e.zh: 俄国地方自治会在该省修建了学校和诊所。

e.en: Reformers saw the {zemstvo} as a step toward local self-government.
e.zh: 改革者把俄国地方自治会视为迈向地方自治的一步。

e.en: Visitors were not allowed inside the {zenana}.
e.zh: 访客不得进入南亚家庭中的妇女内室。

e.en: The novel describes conversations within the {zenana}.
e.zh: 小说描写了妇女内室里的谈话。

e.en: The monks entered the {zendo} before sunrise.
e.zh: 僧侣们在日出前进入禅堂。

e.en: Please keep your phone silent inside the {zendo}.
e.zh: 在坐禅室内请把手机调成静音。

e.en: The machinist will {zenkerize} the hole before fitting the screw.
e.zh: 机械师会先用锥口钻扩孔，再安装螺丝。

e.en: They {zenkerized} each opening to seat the bolt heads neatly.
e.zh: 他们把每个孔口都锥形扩孔，好让螺栓头整齐嵌入。

e.en: The chart used a {zenocentric} frame for the moon's orbit.
e.zh: 这张图用以木星为中心的坐标系表示卫星轨道。

e.en: Astronomers calculated the probe's {zenocentric} longitude.
e.zh: 天文学家计算了探测器的木心黄经。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {zalcitabine} for the viral infection.
e.zh: 医生为这种病毒感染开了扎西他滨。

e.en: Older HIV treatments sometimes included {zalcitabine}.
e.zh: 较早的艾滋病治疗有时会使用扎西他滨。

e.en: She wore a dark {zalpin} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她肩上披着一条深色针织披肩。

e.en: The old portrait shows a woman in a {zalpin}.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像里有个戴着头巾的女子。

e.en: The shepherd pulled on his {zamarra} before dawn.
e.zh: 牧羊人在黎明前穿上了羊皮外套。

e.en: A heavy {zamarra} hung beside the door.
e.zh: 门旁挂着一件厚重的粗毛皮衣。

zambo.t: 桑博人，非裔与美洲原住民混血者

e.en: The colonial record described him as a {zambo}.
e.zh: 殖民时期的记录把他描述为桑博人。

e.en: Today the term {zambo} can sound dated or offensive.
e.zh: 如今桑博人这个称呼可能显得过时或冒犯。

zambomba.t: 桑邦巴鼓，西班牙摩擦鼓

e.en: Children played a {zambomba} during the Christmas procession.
e.zh: 孩子们在圣诞游行中敲奏桑邦巴鼓。

e.en: The folk song was accompanied by a rough {zambomba}.
e.zh: 那首民歌由一面粗犷的桑邦巴鼓伴奏。

zamboninite.t: 赞博尼石，一种稀有矿物

e.en: The museum displayed a tiny sample of {zamboninite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一小块赞博尼石标本。

e.en: Only specialists could identify {zamboninite} in the rock.
e.zh: 只有专家才能在岩石中认出赞博尼石。

e.en: The census category listed several families as {zambos}.
e.zh: 人口普查类别把几户家庭列为桑博人。

e.en: Historians now discuss {zambos} with more careful language.
e.zh: 历史学家如今会更谨慎地讨论桑博人。

zambra.t: 桑布拉舞；摩尔式歌舞会

e.en: The dancers performed a lively {zambra} at midnight.
e.zh: 舞者们在午夜表演了热烈的桑布拉舞。

e.en: Travelers described the {zambra} as music, dance, and celebration.
e.zh: 旅行者把桑布拉歌舞会描述成音乐、舞蹈与庆典。

e.en: A {zamia} grew slowly in the greenhouse.
e.zh: 温室里有一株泽米属植物缓慢生长。

e.en: The botanist warned that {zamia} seeds can be poisonous.
e.zh: 植物学家提醒说泽米的种子可能有毒。

e.en: The {zamindar} collected rents from several villages.
e.zh: 这位印度地主向几个村庄收取地租。

e.en: Under colonial rule, a {zamindar} often held great local power.
e.zh: 在殖民统治下，包税地主常掌握很大的地方权力。

zamindari.t: 印度地主制度；地主领地

e.en: The reform abolished the old {zamindari} system.
e.zh: 这项改革废除了旧的印度地主制度。

e.en: His family lost its {zamindari} after independence.
e.zh: 独立后，他家失去了地主领地。

zamindary.t: 印度地主制度；地主身份

e.en: The novel criticizes the cruelty of {zamindary}.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了印度地主制度的残酷。

e.en: He inherited a small {zamindary} from his father.
e.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了一小片地主领地。

e.en: The islanders once prepared {zamium} from local plants.
e.zh: 岛民曾用当地植物制取泽米淀粉。

e.en: Improperly processed {zamium} could make people ill.
e.zh: 处理不当的泽米淀粉可能使人生病。

e.en: The gloves were made of soft {zamouse}.
e.zh: 这副手套是用柔软的小羚羊皮革制成的。

e.en: He polished the lens with a piece of {zamouse}.
e.zh: 他用一块软皮擦亮镜片。

e.en: The scholar compared {Zan} with neighboring Caucasian languages.
e.zh: 那位学者把赞语同邻近的高加索语言作比较。

e.en: Some villagers still preserve old {Zan} traditions.
e.zh: 一些村民仍保留着古老的赞族传统。

e.en: The chemist isolated {zanaloin} from the aloe extract.
e.zh: 化学家从芦荟提取物中分离出赞芦荟苷。

e.en: Few modern readers will encounter {zanaloin} outside pharmacology.
e.zh: 现代读者很少会在药理学之外遇到赞芦荟苷这个词。

e.en: The museum displayed a {zenographic} scroll from Japan.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅来自日本的禅宗图像卷轴。

e.en: Her essay examined {zenographic} symbols in medieval painting.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了中世纪绘画中的禅宗图像符号。

e.en: His {zenophobia} made him dismiss every meditation practice.
e.zh: 他对禅宗的反感让他否定一切冥想练习。

e.en: The article used {zenophobia} to describe a cultural prejudice.
e.zh: 这篇文章用“禅宗恐惧”来描述一种文化偏见。

e.en: The filter uses a {zeolitic} material to trap impurities.
e.zh: 这种过滤器使用沸石材料来吸附杂质。

e.en: Geologists found {zeolitic} layers inside the volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山岩中发现了含沸石的层状结构。

e.en: Heat and water can {zeolitize} volcanic ash over time.
e.zh: 热量和水分会随着时间使火山灰沸石化。

e.en: The lab tried to {zeolitize} the sample under pressure.
e.zh: 实验室试图在压力下使样品转化为沸石。

e.en: The refrigerant blend behaves as a {zeotrope} during boiling.
e.zh: 这种制冷剂混合物在沸腾时表现为共沸物。

e.en: Engineers measured the {zeotrope} before redesigning the system.
e.zh: 工程师在重新设计系统前测量了这种恒沸混合物。

e.en: We bought warm {zeppole} at the street festival.
e.zh: 我们在街头节庆上买了热乎的意式炸甜面团。

e.en: The bakery dusted the {zeppole} with powdered sugar.
e.zh: 面包店在这些意式炸甜点上撒了糖粉。

zero-address.t: 零地址的；无地址操作的

e.en: A stack machine can use a {zero-address} instruction format.
e.zh: 栈式机器可以使用零地址指令格式。

e.en: The manual explains how {zero-address} commands reduce operand fields.
e.zh: 手册说明了零地址命令如何减少操作数字段。

e.en: Turn the {zero-adjuster} before taking a pressure reading.
e.zh: 读取压力前先转动调零器。

e.en: The technician replaced the faulty {zero-adjuster} on the gauge.
e.zh: 技术员更换了仪表上有故障的零位调节器。

e.en: The scale needs {zero-adjustment} before each experiment.
e.zh: 每次实验前都需要对天平进行调零。

e.en: Accurate {zero-adjustment} reduced the measurement error.
e.zh: 准确的零点校准减少了测量误差。

e.en: The committee chose a {zero-base} budget review.
e.zh: 委员会选择进行零基预算审查。

e.en: A {zero-base} index starts counting from zero.
e.zh: 零基索引从零开始计数。

e.en: The company adopted {zero-based} budgeting this year.
e.zh: 公司今年采用了零基预算。

e.en: Python lists are {zero-based}, so the first item is index 0.
e.zh: Python列表从零开始编号，所以第一项的索引是0。

e.en: Tune the oscillator until you hear a {zero-beat} signal.
e.zh: 调节振荡器，直到听到零拍信号。

e.en: The operator used {zero-beat} tuning to match the frequency.
e.zh: 操作员用零拍调谐来匹配频率。

e.en: The old battery showed {zero-capacity} after years in storage.
e.zh: 这块旧电池存放多年后显示为零容量。

e.en: A {zero-capacity} channel cannot transmit useful information.
e.zh: 零容量信道无法传输有用信息。

e.en: The sensor applies {zero-compensation} when temperature changes.
e.zh: 温度变化时，传感器会进行零点补偿。

e.en: Without {zero-compensation}, the readings drifted throughout the test.
e.zh: 没有零点补偿，读数在整个测试过程中不断漂移。

e.en: The file format uses {zero-compression} to save space.
e.zh: 这种文件格式使用零值压缩来节省空间。

e.en: Database logs became smaller after {zero-compression} was enabled.
e.zh: 启用零压缩后，数据库日志变小了。

e.en: The instrument suffered from {zero-drift} in the afternoon heat.
e.zh: 仪器在下午的高温中出现了零点漂移。

e.en: Regular calibration helps control {zero-drift} in sensitive sensors.
e.zh: 定期校准有助于控制灵敏传感器的零位漂移。

e.en: The algorithm performs {zero-elimination} before solving the matrix.
e.zh: 算法在求解矩阵前会进行消零处理。

e.en: Careful {zero-elimination} made the printed table easier to read.
e.zh: 仔细消除零值后，打印出的表格更容易阅读。

zebec.t: 地中海小帆船；三桅帆船

e.en: The old {zebec} carried spices across the Mediterranean.
e.zh: 那艘老式地中海小帆船载着香料穿越地中海。

e.en: A model {zebec} stood in the maritime museum.
e.zh: 一艘地中海小帆船模型陈列在海事博物馆里。

zebeck.t: 地中海小帆船；三桅帆船

e.en: The pirate's {zebeck} moved quickly along the coast.
e.zh: 那艘海盗的地中海小帆船沿着海岸快速航行。

e.en: She studied a drawing of a Turkish {zebeck}.
e.zh: 她研究了一幅土耳其地中海小帆船的图纸。

e.en: Scientists use {zebrafish} to study early development.
e.zh: 科学家用斑马鱼研究早期发育过程。

e.en: A tiny {zebrafish} swam through the clear tank.
e.zh: 一条小小的斑马鱼在清澈的水箱里游动。

e.en: The mask had a painted {zebrahead} on the front.
e.zh: 面具正面画着一个斑马头形图案。

e.en: Divers photographed a {zebrahead} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近拍到了一条斑纹鱼。

e.en: The fabric had a bold {zebraic} pattern.
e.zh: 这块布料带有醒目的斑马式条纹。

e.en: His jacket looked almost {zebraic} under the lights.
e.zh: 他的夹克在灯光下几乎像斑马纹一样。

e.en: The cabinet was made from polished {zebrawood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用抛光的斑马木做成的。

e.en: Dark lines give {zebrawood} its striking appearance.
e.zh: 深色纹理让斑纹木显得格外醒目。

e.en: The animal had a distinctly {zebrine} coat.
e.zh: 那只动物的皮毛明显带有斑马般的纹路。

e.en: Artists copied the {zebrine} stripes onto the costume.
e.zh: 艺术家把斑马式条纹复制到了服装上。

zebroid.t: 斑马杂交种；似斑马动物

e.en: The sanctuary kept a rare {zebroid} in a separate paddock.
e.zh: 保护区把一匹罕见的斑马杂交种单独养在围栏里。

e.en: A {zebroid} often shows stripes only on part of its body.
e.zh: 斑马杂交种通常只在身体部分区域显出条纹。

e.en: The {zebrula} inherited stripes from its zebra father.
e.zh: 这匹斑马驴从斑马父亲那里遗传了条纹。

e.en: Visitors gathered to see the unusual {zebrula}.
e.zh: 游客聚在一起观看这匹少见的斑马驴。

e.en: The ranch advertised a young {zebrule} for breeding research.
e.zh: 牧场展示了一匹用于繁殖研究的年轻斑马杂交后代。

e.en: A {zebrule} may look more like a horse than a zebra.
e.zh: 斑马杂交后代有时看起来更像马而不是斑马。

e.en: The museum displayed a gold {zecchino} from Venice.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚来自威尼斯的古金币。

e.en: Merchants once trusted the {zecchino} across Europe.
e.zh: 商人过去在欧洲各地都信任这种威尼斯金币。

e.en: He found a worn {zechin} in the collection.
e.zh: 他在藏品中发现了一枚磨损的威尼斯古金币。

e.en: The trader paid with a bright {zechin}.
e.zh: 那名商人用一枚闪亮的威尼斯金币付款。

e.en: The noblewoman traveled in a covered {zedan}.
e.zh: 那位贵妇乘坐一辆带篷的轿式马车出行。

e.en: Servants carried the old {zedan} through the gate.
e.zh: 仆人们抬着那顶旧轿椅穿过大门。

e.en: The herbalist added dried {zedoary} to the mixture.
e.zh: 草药师在配方里加入了干莪术。

e.en: {Zedoary} has a sharp, gingerlike smell.
e.zh: 莪术有一种刺鼻而类似生姜的气味。

e.en: The zoo announced the birth of a {zedonk}.
e.zh: 动物园宣布一头斑马驴出生了。

e.en: A {zedonk} can have striped legs and a donkey's body.
e.zh: 斑马驴可能有带条纹的腿和驴的身体。

e.en: Food scientists extracted {zein} from corn gluten.
e.zh: 食品科学家从玉米麸质中提取玉米醇溶蛋白。

e.en: A thin {zein} coating can protect some tablets.
e.zh: 薄薄的玉米醇溶蛋白涂层可以保护某些药片。

zanily.t: 滑稽可笑地；疯癫地；古怪地

e.en: He grinned {zanily} at the camera.
e.zh: 他对着镜头滑稽地咧嘴笑。

e.en: The actor danced {zanily} across the stage.
e.zh: 那个演员疯疯癫癫地跳过舞台。

e.en: The chemist identified a {zanthogenate} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出一种黄原酸盐。

e.en: Some old papers call this compound a {zanthogenate}.
e.zh: 一些旧论文把这种化合物称为黄原酸酯。

e.en: His speech was full of cheerful {zanyism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了欢快的滑稽作风。

e.en: The film mistakes loud {zanyism} for real comedy.
e.zh: 这部电影把吵闹的荒唐举动误当成真正的喜剧。

e.en: She played a small {zanza} by the fire.
e.zh: 她在火边弹奏一把小桑扎琴。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {zanza} from Central Africa.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自中非的旧拇指琴。

zapateado.t: 萨帕特阿多舞；踢踏舞步

e.en: The dancer ended with a sharp {zapateado}.
e.zh: 舞者以一段有力的萨帕特阿多舞步收尾。

e.en: Students practiced {zapateado} in the flamenco class.
e.zh: 学生们在弗拉门戈课上练习踢踏舞步。

zapateo.t: 弗拉门戈踢踏步；踏脚舞

e.en: Her {zapateo} echoed through the hall.
e.zh: 她的弗拉门戈踢踏声回荡在大厅里。

e.en: The teacher slowed the {zapateo} for beginners.
e.zh: 老师为初学者放慢了这段踏脚舞步。

e.en: The pilot checked the {zapflap} before landing.
e.zh: 飞行员在降落前检查了减速襟翼。

e.en: A damaged {zapflap} changed the aircraft's handling.
e.zh: 受损的减速襟翼改变了飞机的操纵性能。

e.en: The restorer sealed the brass with {zapon}.
e.zh: 修复师用硝化纤维清漆封护黄铜。

e.en: Old labels described the coating as {zapon} varnish.
e.zh: 旧标签把这种涂层称为硝化纤维清漆。

zappy.t: 活泼带劲的；有冲击力的

e.en: The ad used a {zappy} new slogan.
e.zh: 那则广告用了一个活泼有力的新口号。

e.en: Her {zappy} performance woke up the audience.
e.zh: 她充满活力的表演让观众精神一振。

zaptiah.t: 奥斯曼宪兵；土耳其警兵

e.en: A {zaptiah} guarded the old checkpoint.
e.zh: 一名奥斯曼宪兵守着旧检查站。

e.en: The novel mentions a stern {zaptiah} in the village.
e.zh: 小说里提到村中一名严厉的土耳其警兵。

e.en: He wore a bright {zarape} in the parade.
e.zh: 他在游行中披着一条鲜艳的墨西哥彩披毯。

e.en: The shop sold a woven {zarape} from Oaxaca.
e.zh: 店里出售一条来自瓦哈卡的编织彩披毯。

e.en: The scholar studied {Zarathustrian} ritual texts.
e.zh: 那位学者研究琐罗亚斯德教的仪式文本。

e.en: A {Zarathustrian} community once lived there.
e.zh: 那里曾经住着一个琐罗亚斯德教社群。

zarathustric.t: 琐罗亚斯德的；其教义的

e.en: The poem contains several {Zarathustric} themes.
e.zh: 这首诗包含几个琐罗亚斯德教义主题。

e.en: He compared Greek myths with {Zarathustric} ideas.
e.zh: 他把希腊神话与琐罗亚斯德思想作比较。

e.en: The green mineral was identified as {zaratite}.
e.zh: 这种绿色矿物被鉴定为翠镍矿。

e.en: Collectors value bright pieces of {zaratite}.
e.zh: 收藏者看重颜色鲜亮的翠镍矿标本。

e.en: The camp was protected by a thorny {zareba}.
e.zh: 营地由一道荆棘围栏保护着。

e.en: Soldiers built a {zareba} around the wells.
e.zh: 士兵们在水井周围筑起防御营寨。

e.en: The hot coffee came in a silver {zarf}.
e.zh: 热咖啡装在一个银色杯套里端上来。

e.en: She slipped a cardboard {zarf} around the cup.
e.zh: 她给杯子套上一个硬纸杯套。

e.en: Her {zetetic} approach questioned every easy answer.
e.zh: 她那种探究式的方法会质疑每个轻易得出的答案。

e.en: The club encouraged {zetetic} inquiry rather than blind belief.
e.zh: 这个社团鼓励怀疑求证的探究，而不是盲目信从。

e.en: He studied {zetetics} as a method of disciplined inquiry.
e.zh: 他研究探究法，把它当作一种严谨求证的方法。

e.en: Modern {zetetics} values evidence over comfortable assumptions.
e.zh: 现代怀疑求证学重视证据，而不是令人舒服的假设。

e.en: The collector labeled the paired crystal as {zeugite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这枚成对晶体标注为zeugite。

e.en: Under magnification, the {zeugite} showed a neat twin structure.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，这块成对晶体呈现出整齐的孪晶结构。

e.en: A {zeuglodon} fossil was displayed near the museum entrance.
e.zh: 博物馆入口附近展出了一具械齿鲸化石。

e.en: Scientists once thought the {zeuglodon} was a giant sea serpent.
e.zh: 科学家曾以为械齿鲸是一种巨大的海蛇。

zeugma.t: 轭式搭配；一词双关结构

e.en: She used {zeugma} when she broke his car and his heart.
e.zh: 她说自己弄坏了他的车，也伤了他的心，用的是轭式搭配。

e.en: The joke depends on {zeugma} for its sudden twist.
e.zh: 这个笑话靠一词双关的结构产生突然的转折。

zeugmatic.t: 轭式搭配的；一词双关的

e.en: The sentence has a clever {zeugmatic} turn at the end.
e.zh: 这个句子结尾有一个巧妙的一词双关转折。

e.en: Her {zeugmatic} style made the paragraph witty and compact.
e.zh: 她的轭式搭配风格让这一段既风趣又紧凑。

e.en: Early {zeugmatography} helped doctors see soft tissue more clearly.
e.zh: 早期核磁共振成像术帮助医生更清楚地观察软组织。

e.en: The paper described {zeugmatography} before the term MRI became common.
e.zh: 这篇论文在MRI这个说法普及前就描述了核磁共振成像术。

e.en: The old cloak was trimmed with {zibeline}.
e.zh: 那件旧斗篷镶着紫貂皮。

e.en: She chose a soft {zibeline} fabric for the costume.
e.zh: 她为戏服挑了一种柔软的貂皮织物。

e.en: The portrait shows her wearing a {zibelline} collar.
e.zh: 画像中她戴着一条貂皮领子。

e.en: A {zibelline} softness made the coat look expensive.
e.zh: 那种紫貂般的柔软让大衣显得很昂贵。

e.en: The trader described the {zibet} as a small nocturnal animal.
e.zh: 商人把麝猫描述成一种夜行小动物。

e.en: Old perfumes sometimes used {zibet} for a musky note.
e.zh: 旧式香水有时用麝香香料来增添气味。

e.en: The tiny boat was a quick {zigger} in rough water.
e.zh: 那只小船在汹涌水面上灵活地曲折前进。

e.en: He called the nervous puppy a little {zigger}.
e.zh: 他把那只紧张的小狗叫作到处乱转的小家伙。

e.en: The old map showed a strange {ziggzag} through the hills.
e.zh: 旧地图显示山间有一条奇怪的曲折路线。

e.en: Her stitching formed a neat {ziggzag} along the edge.
e.zh: 她的针脚沿边缘形成整齐的锯齿形。

e.en: The garden paths had too much {zigzaggery} for wheelchairs.
e.zh: 花园小径过于曲折，不适合轮椅通行。

e.en: His argument lost force through needless {zigzaggery}.
e.zh: 他的论证因不必要的绕来绕去而失去力量。

e.en: The archaeologists uncovered the base of a {zikkurat}.
e.zh: 考古学家发掘出一座阶梯神庙的底座。

e.en: A painted {zikkurat} dominated the museum display.
e.zh: 一座彩绘阶梯金字塔神庙模型占据了博物馆展区。

e.en: The guide explained how the {zikurat} once served priests.
e.zh: 导游解释这座阶梯神庙从前如何供祭司使用。

e.en: From a distance, the {zikurat} looked like a terraced mountain.
e.zh: 从远处看，那座阶梯金字塔神庙像一座梯田般的山。

e.en: The report compared schools across each {zillah}.
e.zh: 报告比较了各个县区的学校情况。

e.en: A new officer was appointed to the remote {zillah}.
e.zh: 一名新官员被派往那个偏远行政区。

e.en: The collector labeled the small crystal as {zillerite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那颗小晶体标为一种稀有矿物。

e.en: Only a few samples of {zillerite} were kept in the cabinet.
e.zh: 柜子里只保存了少量这种稀有矿物样本。

e.en: The city bought {zero-emission} buses for the new route.
e.zh: 这座城市为新线路购买了零排放公交车。

e.en: A {zero-emission} policy can reduce urban air pollution.
e.zh: 零排放政策可以减少城市空气污染。

e.en: They designed a {zero-energy} house with solar panels.
e.zh: 他们设计了一栋带太阳能板的零能耗住宅。

e.en: Physicists discussed a {zero-energy} state in the model.
e.zh: 物理学家讨论了该模型中的零能量状态。

e.en: The factory aims for {zero-error} production.
e.zh: 这家工厂以零错误生产为目标。

e.en: A {zero-error} result is rare in real measurements.
e.zh: 在真实测量中，无误差结果很少见。

e.en: Astronauts trained in a {zero-g} aircraft.
e.zh: 宇航员在零重力飞机上训练。

e.en: The pen floated across the {zero-g} cabin.
e.zh: 那支笔在失重舱内飘了过去。

e.en: The motor was tested under {zero-load} conditions.
e.zh: 电机在空载条件下进行了测试。

e.en: A {zero-load} reading helps calibrate the instrument.
e.zh: 零负载读数有助于校准仪器。

e.en: The technician used the {zero-method} to compare the voltages.
e.zh: 技术员用零点法比较电压。

e.en: In the {zero-method}, the indicator is balanced before reading.
e.zh: 在调零法中，先让指示器达到平衡再读数。

e.en: The scale needs a {zero-point} adjustment.
e.zh: 这个秤需要进行零点调整。

e.en: Quantum theory includes {zero-point} energy.
e.zh: 量子理论包含零点能。

e.en: The engineer analyzed the filter's {zero-pole} plot.
e.zh: 工程师分析了滤波器的零极点图。

e.en: A {zero-pole} model can describe the circuit response.
e.zh: 零极点模型可以描述电路响应。

e.en: The metal case was connected to a {zero-potential} point.
e.zh: 金属外壳连接到了零电位点。

e.en: The proposal had {zero-potential} without funding.
e.zh: 没有资金支持，这个方案毫无潜力。

e.en: Some exported goods qualify for a {zero-rate} tax treatment.
e.zh: 一些出口商品可适用零税率税务处理。

e.en: The government may {zero-rate} basic food items.
e.zh: 政府可能对基本食品实行零税率。

e.en: Children's books are {zero-rated} for VAT in some countries.
e.zh: 在一些国家，儿童书籍适用增值税零税率。

e.en: The carrier offered {zero-rated} access to the education site.
e.zh: 运营商为该教育网站提供免流量费访问。

e.en: The gauge showed a {zero-reading} before the test began.
e.zh: 测试开始前，仪表显示为零读数。

e.en: A {zero-reading} may mean the sensor is disconnected.
e.zh: 无读数可能表示传感器已断开连接。

e.en: The equation's {zero-set} forms a curve.
e.zh: 这个方程的零点集形成一条曲线。

e.en: Mathematicians study the {zero-set} of the function.
e.zh: 数学家研究这个函数的零集合。

e.en: Temperature changes caused a {zero-shift} in the sensor.
e.zh: 温度变化导致传感器出现零点漂移。

e.en: The technician corrected the {zero-shift} before recording data.
e.zh: 技术员在记录数据前修正了零位偏移。

e.en: They treated the negotiation as a {zero-sum} game.
e.zh: 他们把这场谈判当作零和博弈。

e.en: Politics need not be a {zero-sum} struggle.
e.zh: 政治不一定是零和斗争。

e.en: The chemist studied a {zero-valent} iron compound.
e.zh: 化学家研究了一种零价铁化合物。

e.en: {Zero-valent} metals can react strongly with pollutants.
e.zh: 零价金属可能与污染物发生强烈反应。

e.en: The match ended {zero-zero} after extra time.
e.zh: 加时赛后，比赛以零比零结束。

e.en: He wrote {zero-zero} as the starting coordinates.
e.zh: 他把零零写作起始坐标。

e.en: The lab used a {zerobalance} for precise weighing.
e.zh: 实验室用零位天平进行精密称重。

e.en: The circuit returned to {zerobalance} after calibration.
e.zh: 校准后，电路恢复到零平衡状态。

e.en: The clinic once used {zeroradiography} for breast imaging.
e.zh: 这家诊所曾用静电放射成像术进行乳腺成像。

e.en: {Zeroradiography} produces images by an electrostatic process.
e.zh: 静电放射成像术通过静电过程生成图像。

e.en: After weeks of overtime, she felt {zestless} and tired.
e.zh: 连续加班数周后，她感到缺乏热情又疲惫。

e.en: The speech was accurate but strangely {zestless}.
e.zh: 这场演讲内容准确，却莫名显得乏味。

e.en: The dancer clicked her {zills} in time with the drum.
e.zh: 舞者随着鼓点敲响手上的小钹。

e.en: A pair of brass {zills} lay beside the costume.
e.zh: 一对黄铜指钹放在那套舞衣旁边。

e.en: The coating contains a {zinc-silicate} binder.
e.zh: 这种涂层含有硅酸锌黏结剂。

e.en: Geologists identified the pale mineral as {zinc-silicate}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种浅色矿物鉴定为锌硅酸盐。

e.en: The specimen was labeled {zincaluminite} in the museum drawer.
e.zh: 博物馆抽屉里的标本被标为锌铝矾。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {zincaluminite} formed along the fracture.
e.zh: 裂缝边缘形成了细小的锌铝矾晶体。

e.en: The bath deposits a thin {zincate} layer on aluminum.
e.zh: 这种溶液会在铝表面沉积一层薄薄的锌酸盐层。

e.en: Engineers {zincate} the parts before nickel plating.
e.zh: 工程师在镀镍前先用锌酸盐处理这些零件。

e.en: The chemist described the residue as {zincic}.
e.zh: 化学家把这份残留物描述为含锌物质。

e.en: Old manuals sometimes use {zincic} for zinc compounds.
e.zh: 旧手册有时用zincic来指锌化合物。

e.en: The company surveyed a {zinciferous} vein near the ridge.
e.zh: 公司勘测了山脊附近一条含锌矿脉。

e.en: Miners followed the {zinciferous} rock deeper underground.
e.zh: 矿工沿着含锌岩层向更深处开采。

e.en: The report compares galvanizing with {zincification}.
e.zh: 报告比较了镀锌和锌化处理。

e.en: Surface {zincification} improved the metal's resistance to rust.
e.zh: 表面锌化提高了这种金属的防锈能力。

e.en: The plant can {zincify} small steel fittings.
e.zh: 这家工厂能给小型钢配件镀锌。

e.en: They {zincified} the surface to slow corrosion.
e.zh: 他们把表面锌化以减缓腐蚀。

e.en: The alloy began to {zincilate} in the alkaline solution.
e.zh: 这种合金在碱性溶液中开始形成锌酸盐。

e.en: Technicians {zincilate} aluminum before adding the final coating.
e.zh: 技术人员在加最终涂层前先对铝进行锌化处理。

e.en: The red crystal was identified as {zincite}.
e.zh: 这块红色晶体被鉴定为红锌矿。

e.en: Collectors value bright {zincite} from old furnace deposits.
e.zh: 收藏者看重旧炉渣中鲜亮的红锌矿。

e.en: The gray needles in the ore were {zinckenite}.
e.zh: 矿石中的灰色针状晶体是硫锑铅矿。

e.en: A thin vein of {zinckenite} crossed the polished sample.
e.zh: 一条细细的硫锑铅矿脉穿过抛光样品。

e.en: The old text called the compound {zinckic} oxide.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种化合物称作锌氧化物。

e.en: A {zinckic} solution was prepared for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中配制了一种含锌溶液。

e.en: The miners tested the {zinckiferous} ore for purity.
e.zh: 矿工检测了这批含锌矿石的纯度。

e.en: Maps marked several {zinckiferous} deposits in the valley.
e.zh: 地图标出了山谷里几处富锌矿床。

e.en: The water had a faint {zincky} taste.
e.zh: 这水有一点淡淡的锌味。

e.en: A {zincky} film covered the old metal sheet.
e.zh: 旧金属板上覆着一层像锌的薄膜。

e.en: The archive kept a faded {zinco} of the town map.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着一张褪色的城镇地图锌版印刷品。

e.en: He bought a small {zinco} from the print dealer.
e.zh: 他从版画商那里买了一幅小锌版画。

e.en: The battery used a replaceable {zincode}.
e.zh: 这种电池使用可更换的锌电极。

e.en: Corrosion around the {zincode} reduced the cell's output.
e.zh: 锌阳极周围的腐蚀降低了电池输出。

e.en: The book included a detailed {zincograph} of the harbor.
e.zh: 书中附有一幅细致的港口锌版印刷图。

e.en: She restored the damaged {zincograph} for the exhibition.
e.zh: 她为展览修复了那幅受损的锌版画。

e.en: The {zincographer} prepared the plate by hand.
e.zh: 那位锌版印刷工手工准备了印版。

e.en: A skilled {zincographer} could reproduce fine lettering.
e.zh: 熟练的锌版画师能复制精细的字形。

e.en: The museum displayed several {zincographic} maps.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几张锌版印刷地图。

e.en: Her notes describe the {zincographic} process in detail.
e.zh: 她的笔记详细描述了锌版印刷工艺。

e.en: The workshop taught basic {zincography} to art students.
e.zh: 工作坊向艺术学生教授基础锌版印刷术。

e.en: Before cheap photography, {zincography} helped reproduce maps.
e.zh: 在廉价摄影普及前，锌版印刷术有助于复制地图。

e.en: The chemist described the pale residue as {zincoid} in appearance.
e.zh: 化学家说那种淡色残渣外观上像锌。

e.en: A {zincoid} coating protected the small metal part.
e.zh: 一层类似锌的涂层保护了这个小金属零件。

e.en: The archive preserves a rare {zincolith} from the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着一幅十九世纪罕见的锌版石印画。

e.en: She studied how each {zincolith} captured fine architectural lines.
e.zh: 她研究每幅锌版平印如何呈现精细的建筑线条。

e.en: The museum catalog lists the map as a {zincotype}.
e.zh: 博物馆目录把这张地图列为锌版印刷品。

e.en: Printers used {zincotype} when they needed durable image plates.
e.zh: 印刷工需要耐用图版时会使用锌版印刷。

e.en: The sample formed a {zincous} compound under heat.
e.zh: 样品受热后形成了一种含锌化合物。

e.en: A faint {zincous} taste remained in the solution.
e.zh: 溶液里还残留着一丝锌质味道。

e.en: The old bucket had a sharp, {zincy} smell after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后那个旧桶散发出刺鼻的锌味。

e.en: He disliked the {zincy} aftertaste of the mineral water.
e.zh: 他不喜欢那种矿泉水里像锌一样的余味。

e.en: The label probably meant {zine-sulphide}, an old spelling error for zinc sulphide.
e.zh: 标签上大概写的是硫化锌，只是用了旧式误拼。

e.en: The formula beside {zine-sulphide} matched zinc sulphide exactly.
e.zh: 硫化锌旁边的化学式与zinc sulphide完全相符。

e.en: The biologist found a {zingel} in the fast, stony river.
e.zh: 生物学家在湍急多石的河里发现了一条梭鲈属鱼。

e.en: A {zingel} can cling close to the riverbed while feeding.
e.zh: 梭鲈属鱼觅食时能贴近河床活动。

e.en: Fresh ginger releases {zingerone} when it is cooked.
e.zh: 鲜姜在烹煮时会释放出姜酮。

e.en: Researchers tested {zingerone} for its warm, spicy aroma.
e.zh: 研究人员检测姜酮所带来的温热辛香气味。

e.en: The garden displayed several {zingiberaceous} plants with fragrant roots.
e.zh: 园中展示了几种根部芳香的姜科植物。

e.en: A {zingiberaceous} aroma rose from the crushed leaves.
e.zh: 被碾碎的叶子散发出类似姜的香气。

e.en: The oil contained {zingiberine}, which gave it a ginger scent.
e.zh: 这种油含有姜烯，因此带有姜的气味。

e.en: Scientists measured {zingiberine} in samples from dried ginger.
e.zh: 科学家测量了干姜样品中的姜烯含量。

e.en: The collector bought a dark crystal of {zinkenite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块深色的辉锑铅矿晶体。

e.en: Under the lens, {zinkenite} showed fine metallic needles.
e.zh: 在镜头下，辉锑铅矿呈现出细小的金属针状结构。

e.en: The workshop planned to {zinkify} the iron fittings.
e.zh: 工坊计划给这些铁配件镀锌。

e.en: Manufacturers may {zinkify} steel to slow corrosion.
e.zh: 制造商可能会给钢材镀锌以减缓腐蚀。

e.en: The factory used {zinking} to protect the fence posts.
e.zh: 工厂用镀锌处理来保护围栏柱。

e.en: Poor {zinking} left patches of rust on the hinges.
e.zh: 镀锌处理不佳，使铰链上出现了锈斑。

e.en: A small piece of {zinkite} glowed orange under the lamp.
e.zh: 一小块红锌矿在灯下泛着橙色光泽。

e.en: The guide explained that {zinkite} is a zinc oxide mineral.
e.zh: 导览员解释说红锌矿是一种氧化锌矿物。

e.en: The mineral drawer contained a fragile sample of {zinkosite}.
e.zh: 矿物抽屉里有一块易碎的锌矾样品。

e.en: Geologists identified {zinkosite} near the old zinc works.
e.zh: 地质学家在旧锌厂附近鉴定出了锌矾。

e.en: The tap water tasted slightly {zinky} after repairs.
e.zh: 维修后自来水尝起来有点锌味。

e.en: A {zinky} sheen covered the newly treated bolts.
e.zh: 新处理过的螺栓表面有一层像锌的光泽。

e.en: The pamphlet attacked {Zionism} in harsh terms.
e.zh: 那本小册子用激烈措辞攻击犹太复国主义。

e.en: She studied the history of {Zionism} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究犹太复国主义的历史。

e.en: Please write your {zip code} clearly.
e.zh: 请把你的邮政编码写清楚。
